fixed.summary: A display frame between ticks (a 120 Hz screen on a 60 Hz tick, ProMotion) blends each og.motion agent's pose from the tick before's at the frame's alpha, as og-anim's poses are (translation and scale lerped, rotation slerped), instead of holding the tick's pose until the next. Captures, the probe and frames on a tick boundary draw the tick; the blend steps nothing and stays outside the presentation checkpoint and its hash.
